responsibility: Defines the PA64 HP-UX linker-selection options. It adds `-mgnu-ld` and `-mhp-ld` as mutually inverse target flags so the PA64 HP-UX headers can choose the correct link specs, library forms, and startup conventions for GNU ld versus HP ld.
same_name_distinction: PA64 HP-UX option-table file: unlike pa64-hpux.h, it only declares the linker-selection switches mgnu-ld and mhp-ld that the header's specs test to choose between GNU ld and HP ld behaviors.
